about_the_game:
Welcome to the grounds of Summercamp.
We’re developing this game with a deep love for what inspired its creation:

Choose your character from 8 counselors (with more to come!) and 3 slasher variations.
Each slasher comes with unique killing equipment, while counselors have multiple clothing options.
It's also good to note that every character has different stats, so choose wisely!


Additional killing packs and clothing DLCs will be released after launch. *

Thanks for reading this far, add it to your wishlist now!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 2GB / AMD HD 7870 2GB (with Vulkan support)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Quad-Core or Apple Silicon (via Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

name: Summercamp

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Quad CPU Q6600 @ 2.40GHz / AMD Phenom 9850 Quad-Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 Compatible GeForce GTX 460 1GB or AMD HD 6850 2GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Survive in the campgrounds around the fictional lake camp during the 1980s, or you may be the slaughter himself. Unlike usual horror games, experience party-like game in lobbies all around world! Highly inspired by Friday the 13th.
